description: Read where the app thinks it is, as the Location tool (@buoy-gg/location) sees it: real or overridden (pinned place, route with progress and speed), the position the app gets right now, GPS signal and location-services switches, which location libraries are overridden, the app's live location watches, its geofencing regions with inside/outside state and distance, background location tasks, and recent location events (requests, geofence enters and exits, errors). Check this before calling a distance, nearby list, geofence or location permission flow a bug.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.
